notes: Two of the verse's coordinators answer to no waw — `בָּאוּ שָׁמָּה` and `לָקְחוּ` are asyndetic — so both are `added` under rule 14's closing count rather than folded into the verbs beside them.
The waw before `שֵׁשׁ מֵאוֹת הָאִישׁ` is rendered *with*, which rule 14's open list expressly includes.

The article on `אִישׁ` takes the phrase's single *the* while the agreement article on `הֶחָגוּר` is unrepresented (rule 47), and the article on `הַמִּלְחָמָה` is unrepresented because the ASV writes *weapons of war* with no *the* at all (rule 29).
